steps.name: install-stage9d-runner-and-preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = d7b2bcf60f73e7d834a000bcf2a7f6d6e5adae5d; test -f build/climate_v6_full_seed1847_vpd.npz; test -f reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.npz; test -f reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847_vpd.json; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage9d/run_vpd_closed_loop.py > tools/ml/run_vpd_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/run_vpd_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/run_vpd_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py -q; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: full-held-out-rh-vpd-closed-loop
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python tools/ml/run_vpd_closed_loop.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_closed_loop_seed91273_vpd.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['schema_version'] == 6
assert d['config']['workers'] == 6
assert d['config']['scenarios_per_family'] == 2
assert d['config']['steps_per_scenario'] == 60
assert len(d['families']) == 15
assert len(d['episodes']) == 90
assert d['leakage_check']['overlap_count'] == 0
for policy in ('rule','teacher','ml'):
    assert d['aggregate'][policy]['episodes'] == 30
    assert d['aggregate'][policy]['steps'] == 1800
print('STAGE9D_REPORT_GATE=PASS verdict=' + ('PASS' if d['verdict']['accepted'] else 'NO_GO'))
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/run_vpd_closed_loop.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage9d
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/run_vpd_closed_loop.py reports/ml/climate_v6_closed_loop_seed91273_vpd.json; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/run_vpd_closed_loop.py reports/ml/climate_v6_closed_loop_seed91273_vpd.json; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Benchmark RH and VPD climate model closed loop'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
